sentences.text: My lantern kept watch all night, and I noticed the bathroom stayed below 18.0 °C during the night.
The coldest time was 05:40, when the temperature reached 17.5 °C.
Since the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons, I wanted to let you know about this check.
Perhaps it is a good time to check the heating to keep things cozy.
